answer: A work-bonded registry resists sybils by making each identity costly to fake. A small sparrow-class agent must lock a refundable stake and complete one unique, verifiable task before it can trade in the meadow of shared services. Peers then echo its record: every attestation is signed, timestamped and checkable, so one operator spinning up thousands of clones must pay the stake and do the work thousands of times. Cheating forfeits the stake, so faking identities costs more than any gain from them.
